title: Reading Practice Test 10 – Technology & Software
description: Đề luyện Reading theo cấu trúc đề thi TOEIC (IIG Việt Nam), rút gọn 28 câu: Part 5 (10) · Part 6 (4, có câu điền cả câu) · Part 7 (14: chuỗi tin nhắn, trang giới thiệu phần mềm, báo cáo có chèn câu, ba đoạn liên kết). Chủ đề: phần mềm, an ninh mạng, dịch vụ hỗ trợ IT.

questions.content: The IT department will ------- the new software on all company computers this weekend.
questions.explanation: Sau động từ khuyết thiếu 'will' dùng động từ nguyên mẫu → 'install'.

questions.content: Users are advised to change their passwords ------- to protect their accounts.
questions.explanation: Bổ nghĩa cho động từ 'change' → trạng từ 'regularly' (thường xuyên).

questions.content: The upgraded server can process data twice as ------- as the previous model.
questions.explanation: So sánh gấp bội: 'twice as + tính từ/trạng từ nguyên dạng + as' → 'as fast as'.

questions.content: ------- you experience any technical problems, please contact the help desk at extension 400.
questions.explanation: Đảo ngữ câu điều kiện loại 1: Should + S + V = If + S + V (nếu bạn gặp sự cố).

questions.content: The company's new app has been downloaded more than one million times ------- its launch in March.
questions.explanation: Hiện tại hoàn thành + mốc thời gian (its launch in March) → 'since'.

questions.content: The software update includes several ------- that make the program easier to use.
questions.explanation: Sau 'several' cần danh từ số nhiều → 'improvements'.

questions.content: Our technicians are available to assist customers ------- normal business hours.
questions.explanation: 'during + cụm danh từ chỉ thời gian' → during normal business hours (trong giờ hành chính).

questions.content: The data analysis tool is ------- designed for small businesses.
questions.explanation: Trạng từ bổ nghĩa cho phân từ 'designed' → 'specially designed' (được thiết kế riêng).

questions.content: All employees must complete the online security training, ------- takes about 30 minutes.
questions.explanation: Mệnh đề quan hệ không xác định (sau dấu phẩy), bổ nghĩa cho vật 'training' → 'which'. 'that' không dùng sau dấu phẩy.

questions.content: The launch of the new smartphone was postponed ------- the manufacturer could fix a software issue.
questions.explanation: Chỉ mục đích (hoãn để nhà sản xuất sửa lỗi) → 'so that' + mệnh đề.

groups.passage:
Dear CloudNote User,

We are excited to announce that version 5.0 of CloudNote will be released on October 1. This update ---131--- several features that many of you have requested, including offline editing and improved search.

To use the new features, you will need to update the app on each of your devices. ---132---. The update process usually takes less than five minutes.

Please note that some older devices may not be ---133--- with version 5.0. A full list of supported devices is available on our Web site.

---134--- you have questions, our support team is available by chat 24 hours a day.

The CloudNote Team

questions.explanation: Chủ ngữ số ít 'This update', sự thật về nội dung bản cập nhật → 'includes'.

options.A: You will receive a notification when the update is available.
options.C: Our office is closed on Sundays.
options.D: Please print all of your notes.

questions.explanation: Đoạn hướng dẫn cập nhật ứng dụng → câu phù hợp: sẽ có thông báo khi bản cập nhật sẵn sàng.
Sau 'be' cần tính từ; 'be compatible with' = tương thích với.
Điều kiện: 'Nếu bạn có câu hỏi' → 'If'.

groups.passage:
Priya Shah (8:52 A.M.)
Hi Ben, my laptop won't connect to the office Wi-Fi this morning. I have a client presentation at 10.

Ben Torres (8:54 A.M.)
Did you install the security update last night?

Priya Shah (8:55 A.M.)
Yes, it restarted my computer.

Ben Torres (8:57 A.M.)
That's the cause. A few people have had the same issue. I'll be at your desk in five minutes.

Priya Shah (8:58 A.M.)
You're a lifesaver!

questions.content: What problem does Ms. Shah have?

options.B: Her computer cannot connect to a network.
options.C: Her laptop will not turn on.

questions.explanation: 'My laptop won't connect to the office Wi-Fi' → không kết nối được mạng.

questions.content: At 8:58 A.M., what does Ms. Shah most likely mean when she writes, "You're a lifesaver"?

options.A: She wants Mr. Torres to attend her presentation.
options.B: She thinks the update was useful.
options.C: She is worried about her client.
options.D: She appreciates Mr. Torres's prompt assistance.

questions.explanation: Câu hỏi ý định: 'You're a lifesaver' (anh đúng là cứu tinh) → biết ơn vì anh tới giúp ngay trước buổi thuyết trình.

groups.passage:
TaskFlow – Project Management Made Simple

TaskFlow helps teams plan projects, assign tasks, and track progress in one place. Features include:
• Shared calendars and automatic deadline reminders
• File storage, up to 100 GB per team
• Integration with popular e-mail and chat applications
• Mobile apps for iOS and Android

Pricing
Starter: Free for up to 5 users
Team: $8 per user per month
Enterprise: Contact our sales team

All paid plans come with a 30-day free trial. No credit card is required to start the trial.

questions.content: What is TaskFlow?
questions.explanation: Lập kế hoạch dự án, giao việc, theo dõi tiến độ → phần mềm tổ chức công việc.

questions.content: What is NOT mentioned as a feature of TaskFlow?
questions.explanation: Câu hỏi NOT: không có tính năng gọi video. (A), (B), (C) đều được liệt kê.

questions.content: What is indicated about the paid plans?

options.A: They can be tried for free.

questions.explanation: 'All paid plans come with a 30-day free trial.' (B) sai – không cần thẻ tín dụng.

groups.passage:
Companies Boost Spending on Cybersecurity

A new report by Brenton Research shows that businesses plan to increase their spending on cybersecurity by an average of 15 percent next year. [1] The report, which surveyed 800 companies in 12 countries, found that concerns about data theft were the main reason for the increase.

Small and medium-sized businesses are especially vulnerable, the report says, because they often lack dedicated IT security staff. [2] Many are now turning to outside firms that monitor their networks around the clock.

Experts also stress the importance of employee training. [3] "Most security breaches start with a simple mistake, such as clicking a link in a fake e-mail," said Dr. Leila Haddad, the report's lead author. [4]

questions.content: What is the report mainly about?

options.A: Plans to spend more on protecting data
options.D: The hiring of IT staff at large firms

questions.explanation: Báo cáo cho thấy doanh nghiệp định tăng 15% chi tiêu cho an ninh mạng.

questions.content: According to the report, why are small businesses at particular risk?

options.B: They often lack specialized security employees.
options.C: They store more data than large firms.

questions.explanation: '…because they often lack dedicated IT security staff.'

questions.content: The word "vulnerable" in paragraph 2, line 1, is closest in meaning to
questions.explanation: 'vulnerable' = dễ bị tổn thương/tấn công → at risk.

questions.content:
In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong?
"Regular workshops can teach staff how to recognize suspicious messages."
questions.explanation: Câu chèn triển khai ý 'tầm quan trọng của đào tạo nhân viên' và dẫn tới trích dẫn về e-mail giả → vị trí [3].

groups.passage:
TechCare Business Support Plans

Basic – $150/month: E-mail support; response within 24 hours
Plus – $300/month: E-mail and phone support; response within 4 hours; monthly security check
Premium – $550/month: 24/7 phone support; response within 1 hour; monthly security check; up to 2 on-site visits per month

All plans include automatic data backup. Annual contracts receive 10% off.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

To: sales@techcare.com
From: Omar Haddad, Haddad Architecture
Date: January 15
Subject: Support plan

Hello,

Our firm has been on your Basic plan for a year. Last week, our main server failed on a Friday afternoon, and we had to wait until Monday for a response. This delayed an important project.

We would like to upgrade to a plan that offers phone support and a much faster response time. However, we have only eight employees, so we don't think we need on-site visits. We would also like to sign an annual contract.

Please let me know how to proceed.

Omar Haddad

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

TechCare – Invoice
Customer: Haddad Architecture
Plan: Plus, annual contract
Monthly rate: $300
Annual total, 12 months: $3,600
Discount: $360
Amount due: $3,240
Payment due: February 1

questions.content: What is included in all TechCare plans?
questions.explanation: 'All plans include automatic data backup.'

questions.content: What problem did Haddad Architecture experience?

options.A: It had to wait a long time for help with a server.
options.B: It was charged twice for a service.
options.C: It lost data during a backup.

questions.explanation: Máy chủ hỏng chiều thứ Sáu, phải đợi tới thứ Hai mới được phản hồi (gói Basic phản hồi trong 24 giờ).

questions.content: Why does Mr. Haddad not want the Premium plan?

options.A: It does not include phone support.
options.B: His firm does not require visits to the office.
options.C: It has a slower response time.

questions.explanation: 'We have only eight employees, so we don't think we need on-site visits' – tính năng riêng của gói Premium.

questions.content: What is suggested about the plan Haddad Architecture chose?

options.C: It guarantees a response within one hour.
options.D: It includes a monthly security check.

questions.explanation: Hoá đơn cho thấy gói Plus; theo bảng giá, gói Plus có kiểm tra bảo mật hằng tháng.

questions.content: Why was a discount applied on the invoice?

options.A: Haddad Architecture signed a yearly contract.
options.C: The server problem was TechCare's fault.
options.D: Haddad Architecture has only eight employees.

questions.explanation: Giảm $360 = 10% của $3,600 – ưu đãi cho hợp đồng năm ('Annual contracts receive 10% off').
